checkedProposals.reason: Both same-ID pool variants incorrectly localize a 110–220 V supply as what makes Philippine home appliances safe. Local nominal supply is 230 V and a 110 V appliance needs a matching transformer; arbitrary reduced voltage is not a safety guarantee. Hold G4-M-2 for locally accurate voltage and appliance-rating wording in all languages. Meralco primary source: https://www.meralco.com.ph/residential/help-support/frequently-asked-questions/service-application?page=3 .

Tilapia eating plants and insects directly teaches food interdependence. Only food-and-shelter matches; TL/BIS preserve diet. Pond becoming lake is a minor habitat generalization, not a contradiction.

The worked prediction has unidentified objects and asserts air will not matter without any setup establishing negligible drag. TL also changes land together to magsasama sila (come together) rather than simultaneous landing. Hold G3-M-4 until a self-contained fair prediction example and accurate translation are supplied.
Premolars crushing food is a feeding function of teeth. Only feeding matches; adult/permanent teeth and placement between canines and molars agree in all languages.
A finger pressing a button directly demonstrates pushing an object to move it. Only push matches; all languages preserve the force and movement.

All versions equate a pressure in pascals with weight, omitting per unit area. This teaches a dimensional error; sea-level pressure also varies around the standard reference. Hold G4-E-4 until the air-column weight per unit area is explicit. NWS definition: https://www.weather.gov/source/zhu/ZHU_Training_Page/winds/pressure_winds/Pressure.htm .
Same amount of water is an explicit controlled factor. The fair-test-control facet is substantive; no other facet matches. TL/BIS retain the same control example despite extensive English loans.

BIS describes a linukot (rolled) coconut leaf rather than a woven pouch, and its swelling verb mohabok needs language review. This local food-method sentence should accurately describe the pouch before G3-M-1 recovery; the heating/hydration teaching otherwise fits.

Parasitism inside a host vine supports living-interactions. Both app/merged same-ID restatements and all translations were checked; no alternate ID or meaning conflict. Rafflesia is used as the familiar genus name for the largest-flower example, not a claim that every species is equally large. Kew independently confirms parasitism, absence of ordinary organs and Tetrastigma: https://www.kew.org/plants/rafflesia-arnoldi .
Sunlight refracting, internally reflecting and dispersing in drops explains a familiar natural event and light behavior. Both admitted facets are substantive; full translations preserve the sequence.

Rainbow formation through sunlight bending and separating into colors supplies an everyday natural-event example. Reflection is omitted but not contradicted by this short component. Only local-examples matches; translations agree.

Rapid decomposition and nutrient uptake can keep a litter/organic surface horizon thin, not make the whole rainforest soil profile thin. All versions state the latter. Hold both roots codes until soil is replaced by the correct surface organic layer and cause is clarified. FAO explicitly describes deep tropical profiles with thin A1 horizons: https://www.fao.org/4/x5867e/x5867e03.htm . The original unspecific FAO attribution does not support its thin-soil claim.
Bent-looking straws, eyeglasses, cameras and rainbows are concrete everyday refraction examples. Only local-examples matches; translations retain all examples.

Returning reflected light versus transmitted/refracted light supports the behavior facet. The elementary comparison is not asserting that partial reflection cannot coexist. BIS includes a Tagalog doon but the substantive distinction remains comprehensible; no extra facet matches.
Water bending light and a mirror returning it are substantive contrasting light behaviors. Only behavior matches; TL/BIS retain the distinction.

A fridge is powered throughout the day but does not necessarily draw its rated 350 W continuously; compressor cycling/inverter output matters. The sentence invites a misleading rating-times-24-hours calculation. Hold G8-F-7 until on-time or measured/labelled energy use is distinguished. DOE recommends measured annual energy comparison: https://www.energy.gov/cmei/femp/purchasing-energy-efficient-residential-refrigerators .
Monitor lizards and pythons are explicit reptile examples with a warm-environment trait. Only reptiles matches, without false table-activity credit; translations preserve identification.

Fungal rather than worm causation identifies the organism group. Both translations preserve rash, contact transmission and clean/dry prevention. Only fungi matches. Verified independently against CDC: https://www.cdc.gov/ringworm/about/ .

The specified oil-and-vinegar layers demonstrate a nonuniform everyday mixture. The live unit is named suspensions but explicitly admits heterogeneous examples; this is not falsely claiming the liquids form a solid suspension. Only this facet matches; translations agree.

Salt-water soaking can delay browning, but the categorical blocks oxygen from reacting/prevents browning wording lacks time/concentration conditions and implies complete exclusion despite dissolved oxygen. Hold G4-M-3 until stated as slowing browning by reducing exposure/inhibiting the process. Experimental source discusses rates and concentration rather than a universal barrier: https://www.osjournal.org/ojs/index.php/OSJ/article/download/2581/362 .
Reducing paper consumption to protect trees is a genuine conservation action. Both care-actions and protect-habitats are supported; all languages preserve the action and reason.

A Sun-cast shadow indicates the light direction; it does not prove all yard heat and light come from the Sun, nor does every outdoor shadow point away from it when other lights exist. All translations preserve the invalid proof and all claim. Hold all three codes until limited to a sunlight-cast shadow and separated from a supported solar-heating statement.

Gold/silver shine supplies the physical-property facet and both named-metal facets. All three are substantive. TL/BIS render reflected light loosely as showing light, but preserve the intended shiny/sparkling appearance rather than claiming light emission; no reflection-behavior code is awarded.

notes: Verification of 200 prior decisions: 23 proposed recoveries checked; 15 keep, 8 hold, 0 revise_codes. The other 177 existing holds were scanned for flags only, not reopened or counted as new reviews.

Full EN/TL/BIS, all app+merged stable-fact/card-ID variants, exact competency texts and every live admitted facet inspected. Same-ID wording variants exist for dcard-06945 and ffct-11265; both variants checked. No alternate card IDs found.

All five original apply.py dry runs pass, validating identity/hash, exclusion, grade exclusion/category admission and evidence syntax. Scientific/translation issues in this report are not detected by those dry runs. No shared files, original reviews or ledgers changed.

Source provenance: original proposals mostly provide unnamed general attributions rather than traceable URLs. Independently sourced uncertainty checks are linked in proposal reasons; in particular original generic FAO soil attribution does not support thin whole-soil profiles, and BIPM/NIST standard-atmosphere attribution does not repair pressure-as-weight wording. Source assertions in held rows were not all independently reverified.

Existing held flags retained: ffct-01523 English question in Tagalog; ffct-17067 BIS nutrients instead of substances; dcard-02390 ripening hormone analog called catalyst; ffct-30637 tumatagas (leaks) instead of tumatigas (hardens); ffct-04652 capsaicin in seeds vs placenta. Some other holds impose an entire diagram/table activity requirement on teaching components; those are potential future reconsiderations, not approvals here.
Parent alone changes decisions and integrates. This file is an atomic verification recommendation, not an applied recovery ledger.
